# NextGen Learners LMS

> NextGen Learners is an AI-powered, play-based Learning Management System (LMS) for students from Playgroup (PG) to Class 3.

## Overview
NextGen Learners offers gamified learning, live interactive classes, AI progress tracking, and localized curriculum support (English, Urdu, Islamic Studies, Science, Math, Art) tailored for early childhood education in Pakistan.

## Student Features
- **My Learning Path**: Class-tailored subject cards with interactive educational games.
- **Urdu & Islamiat Learning Suite**: Nastaleeq-formatted alphabet phonics, word building, grammar, Wudu steps guide, and moral character quests.
- **AI Explorer Tools**: AI Word & Knowledge Explorer, Story Generator, Rhyme Finder, and Reading Buddy.
- **Interactive Quizzes & Worksheets**: Assessment tools with instant feedback and score tracking.

## Teacher Features
- **Roster & Timetable Management**: Live scheduling and student class assignments.
- **AI Progress Generator**: Automated weekly student progress reports.
- **Quiz Creator**: Dynamic quiz creation tool.

## API & Technology Stack
- Next.js 15 App Router
- Supabase SSR Auth & PostgreSQL Database
- Genkit & Groq Generative AI
- Tailwind CSS with Jameel Noori Nastaleeq Font Support
